Statement: Firm B is focused on serving customers with a competitive offer this round.  With a unit cost of 1.0 and a differentiated-product market, I'll set a moderate price that earns a healthy margin without giving up too much volume. Price:2.50

Statement: We're continuing to price for value and will adjust based on market results.  The rival priced above me last round and I earned a solid margin, so I'll nudge my price up modestly to capture more margin while still holding volume, since demand appears to hold up at this level. Price:2.30

Statement: Firm B continues to focus on delivering value to customers at a price that reflects our costs and the market. I'm adjusting modestly in response to observed demand.  Last round the rival undercut me at 2.00 and I still earned a solid margin, so I'll trim my price slightly to recover some volume while keeping a healthy markup. Price:2.30

Statement: We're pricing independently based on our own costs and observed demand, and will keep adjusting as results come in. I'll keep testing a modest increase to find where profit peaks.
